title: Meh
text: Meh. I've bought a handful of these from various sellers and so far have the same problem with each: the colors are not are varied and the last two stones are almost identical in color.  You want to be able to easily differentiate what each stone is, not just by chakra placement.  I like the tree of life addition but will continue the hunt for a strand as ideal as the image advertised.
